content.title: Kimberly-Clark to buy Tylenol maker Kenvue, Iren & Microsoft deal
content.description:
There are a number of stocks on the move on Monday, Nov. 3. Kimberly-Clark (KMB) announced it is buying Kenvue (KVUE) in a deal valued at $48.7 billion. Iren (IREN) shares are soaring after striking a $9.7 billion deal with Microsoft (MSFT). Pfizer (PFE) is suing to block Novo Nordisk's (NVO) bid for obesity startup Metsera (MTSR).

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Morning Brief.
